Interface SimulationDefinition

All Known Implementing Classes:
CommonModel, JSimGraphModel, JSIMModel
public interface SimulationDefinition
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: orsotronIII Date: 22-lug-2005 Time: 17.33.22 This interface provides methods for simulation parameters definition. Those include measures and other parameters for simulation setup, such as simulation seed or simulation maximum duration. Modified by Bertoli Marco 3-oct-2005 Modified by Francesco D'Aquino
Author:
Bertoli Marco (new measures) Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Project: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class. Modified by Sturari Nicola (Nov 2014) Desc: Added a parameter representing the maximum simulated time (not real time) before the simulation is stopped

    • setPreloadedJobs

      void setPreloadedJobs(Object stationKey, Object classKey, Integer preload)
      Sets number of preloaded jobs at specified station for specified class. For closed classes, total number of preloaded jobs for a class over all stations must be equal to class population, otherwise update is canceled.
      Parameters:
      stationKey - station at which preloaded jobs are preloaded.
      classKey - class to which preloaded jobs belong.
      preload - number of preloaded jobs.

      total number of preloaded jobs.

    • manageJobs

      void manageJobs()
      This method is used to manage number of jobs for every class. If class is closed all spare jobs will be allocated to its reference source, if for some reasons more jobs are allocated than max population, they are reduced. Uses this method only when strictly necessary as it can be slow if the model is big.
